chunks: With cups from a flowing stream being passed around,

key_terms.مَّعِينٍ: A flowing stream / source of water
key_terms.يُطَافُ: They are circulated around / passed around

ai.seo_question: What is being served to the people of Paradise in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (often linked to Surah As-Saffat 37:47 or Surah Al-Waqi'ah 56:18 depending on the specific manuscript context) emphasizes the purity (kawnan) of the drink, distinguishing it from worldly intoxicants by being free from impurities and hangovers. It reflects the concept of 'Ma'een' as a distinct, flowing spring in Paradise, symbolizing the continuous spiritual and physical refreshment granted to the faithful as a reward for their piety and adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings.
